notes.title: DLC Is Ready.
notes.content:
New addon for Sogo Vego makes gameplay 2-3 times longer 
The informal title is "Untold story". It is a major and free DLC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38378723/b334339189c8bd008b95d7d3e4be142467daea6a.png
Plot
After the events of the original game, toy will play for a new hero, for Mishka. His tasks on the basis are very trivial: collect keys, spread notes, establish contact with monsters. He is a little helper who does small but important work. However, this time something changes. The monsters at the base have become smarter. The tester poses questionable tasks. Subject has escaped from the base. A new friend appears. In new conditions, you have to find out how it all began. In this story, you will find out what is happening behind the screen. In the soup of events, you will become a hero, not just another victim. You are the one who will put an end to what is happening.

notes.title: Christmas and New Year sale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38378723/2902d4001d9dbd39de6a4c9a8c7ff11b2cae2bcb.png

Hey, Friends!

Christmas and New Year are coming! And this means there will be a sale!
Our second game, Sogo Vego, will also participate in this event.

First, I wanted to thank everyone who bought the game! You are our fellows! Thanks to you, we get feedback and improve the game, as well as get the resources to keep developing as a game development team.

Also thanks to everyone who added the game to their "wishlist". This helps to promote the game higher up the list, which means more people can see our product and possibly purchase.

Thank you very much!

Now about one more event. The release of the game Sogo Vego took place on September 16, 2020. For me, as a game designer, this is a great event! During development and before release, my colleague and I constantly tested the game. We found and fixed bugs, we optimized the game as much as possible, we spent a lot of time and money to make the final product perfect for the players. Unfortunately, after the release, many unexpected problems surfaced. Players complained about lags, bugs and various types of inconvenience in the game. It was a shock for us as developers that we overlooked this kind of problem. Of course, we immediately started fixing current problems and improving the game play. The current version of the Sogo Vego game is 1.2. We have almost finished version 1.3 and there is more news!

A NEW FREE BIG DLC TO THE GAME

We worked on it for almost three months, but it was worth it!
Thanks to the new add-on, the duration of the game play will increase three times!

The plot:
After the events of the original Sogo Vego game, we continue the story. The main character is the Bear. He is small, vicious and awkward, which means that the monsters constantly joke and pin him. But Mishka(the bear) has his own weapon, his sharp mind. It was not for nothing that Tester chose him as his minion.
Now he needs to eliminate the mess happening at the base. Many questions were raised by the Player's escape from the base. Tester raises many questions too. Also, why can monsters talk? What is the real role of Mishka in these events? What happened before? What's going on now? And what will come next? You should find out the answers.
The outcome:
Guys, you won't regret if you buy our product. In all fairness, the original game has given me occasional spooks. Now from the new Addon, I experience not only this, but also fits of hysterical laughter :) We tried to make the plot much more varied, more logical and more fun. Much of the Sogo Vego universe can be learned through the add-on.
And lastly:
I wish you Christmas and New Year's miracles and wonderful mood! Thank you for being with us.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Update list:


[olist]
 We changed the light's mechanics. It became completely dark.
 Monsters cannot open the doors
 Added death mechanic. Now the player falls down? after that an inscription appears at the end.
 Some doorways have become wider.
 Added a new character who will try to scare you.
 Fixed mechanic of test rooms.
 Fully voiced Russian, English and Chinese versions.
 Bug with loading has been fixed.
[/olist]


Regarding the big free add-on to the game: 
We are now fully focused on developing the new DLC for Sogo Vego. The plot will be twisted around the characters of the game and presented through the eyes of Mishka (one of the game's antagonists).

The new DLC is associated with a period when there are no players at the base. Bear, Monsters and Tester must prepare a base for the new arrivals, place keys and notes in their places. Most of the work will be done by Mishka. It seemed in a simple task there are pitfalls that you have been stepping on from the very beginning of the add-on. The monsters do not want to help, so you have to contrive to achieve the goal, but you need to be careful, as the Mishka can die.
The expansion will be less about intimidating the player and more about character interactions with each other. Add a tablespoon of adventure and a teaspoon of humor to that.
